: Posts Containing the Local Name of Each Tropical Cyclone {#tbl-storm-names tbl-colwidths="[30,45,25]"}

| Step | Action |
|:-----|:----------------------------------------|
| 1 | Links, usernames, and non-ASCII characters are removed from each post, so that posts differing only in these elements are treated as identical |
| 2 | Each post is represented by the counts of its words and word pairs |
| 3 | The cosine similarity between the counts of two posts is computed, which measures how much wording the two posts share |
| 4 | When the similarity exceeds 0.75, only one of the two posts is kept |

: Posts Matching the Keywords by Collection Window {#tbl-frame-counts tbl-colwidths="[35,40,25]"}


| Step | Action |
|:-----|:----------------------------------------|
| 1 | The share of the day is taken from the daily counts of matching posts |
| 2 | A time within the day is drawn at random, with a fixed random seed |
| 3 | The posts just before that time are requested from the X API in the smallest batch that it allows |
| 4 | The batch is filtered by the inclusion and exclusion criteria, and every eligible post not yet kept is kept |
| 5 | Steps 2 to 4 are repeated until the share is filled |
| 6 | When the day has no more eligible posts, the rest of its share is divided among the other days, and a day with more matching posts receives more of it |
